item: Buried-topics drill lists only the sourced articles the finding counted
summary: Open-on-main row 49, found by the R101 delta read of #2007. find_buried_topics counted a topic's corpus-wide articles (a_t) over a window that requires a source, but its click-through drill re-read the mentions without that gate, so a mention kept for a lost article was listed though never counted. The drill now reads the same window list; one test, red before.
